note: v3's sheets (docs/design/v3-prompts.md §3) and the sprites each is cut into (docs/design/design-system-v3.md §8). A sheet goes into `root` under exactly its `file` name; `python tools/camp_sheet.py --v3` cuts every sheet that is there and lists the rest as awaited. A piece is named by `order`: its place in reading order on the sheet (`--list SHEET` prints it); if the image model drew the sheet in another order, change the numbers, not the names. Sizes are the plan in art px; with `native` the slot is what the sheet draws (rounded up to 8), shown at ×1 (docs/design/design-system-v3.md §3), and `keep_colours` keeps the art's own colours. `degrid` (set on the ork sheets, whose first round came with a box drawn round every cell) drops a drawn grid before the pieces are found; it is off for the others, where it would eat a building's own straight outlines. Each sheet is cut at its own pixel and shown at the whole multiple (`show`, or from `target`) nearest its size on screen; the manifest records each sprite's `pitch` and `show`.
